use PhpCsFixer\AbstractFixer;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\ConfigurableFixerInterface;

use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\TokensAnalyzer;

/**
 * @author VeeWee <toonverwerft@gmail.com>
 * @author Tomas Jadrny <developer@tomasjadrny.cz>
 * @author Greg Korba <greg@codito.dev>
 * @author SpacePossum <possumfromspace@gmail.com>
 */
final class FullyQualifiedStrictTypesFixer extends AbstractFixer implements ConfigurableFixerInterface, WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface
{
    /**
     * @var array{
     *     const?: array<string, class-string>,
     *     class?: array<string, class-string>,
     *     function?: array<string, class-string>
     * }
     */
    private array $symbolsForImport = [];

    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    private array $analysisState = [];

    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    private array $namespaceState = [];

    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    private array $typeState = [];

    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    private array $renderState = [];

    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    private array $tokenCursorState = [];

    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'Removes the leading part of fully qualified symbol references if a given symbol is imported or belongs to the current namespace. Fixes function arguments, exceptions in `catch` block, `extend` and `implements` of classes and interfaces.',
            [
                new CodeSample(
                    '<?php

use Foo\Bar;
use Foo\Bar\Baz;
use Foo\OtherClass;
use Foo\SomeContract;
use Foo\SomeException;

/**
 * @see \Foo\Bar\Baz
 */
class SomeClass extends \Foo\OtherClass implements \Foo\SomeContract
{
    /**
     * @var \Foo\Bar\Baz
     */
    public $baz;

    /**
     * @param \Foo\Bar\Baz $baz
     */
    public function __construct($baz) {
        $this->baz = $baz;
    }

    /**
     * @return \Foo\Bar\Baz
     */
    public function getBaz() {
        return $this->baz;
    }

    public function doX(\Foo\Bar $foo, \Exception $e): \Foo\Bar\Baz
    {
        try {}
        catch (\Foo\SomeException $e) {}
    }
}
'
                ),
                new CodeSample(
                    '<?php

class SomeClass
{
    public function doY(Foo\NotImported $u, \Foo\NotImported $v)
    {
    }
}
',
                    ['leading_backslash_in_global_namespace' => true]
                ),
                new CodeSample(
                    '<?php
namespace {
    use Foo\A;
    try {
        foo();
    } catch (\Exception|\Foo\A $e) {
    }
}
namespace Foo\Bar {
    class SomeClass implements \Foo\Bar\Baz
    {
    }
}
',
                    ['leading_backslash_in_global_namespace' => true]
                ),
                new CodeSample(
                    '<?php

namespace Foo\Test;

class Foo extends \Other\BaseClass implements \Other\Interface1, \Other\Interface2
{
    /** @var \Other\PropertyPhpDoc */
    private $array;
    public function __construct(\Other\FunctionArgument $arg) {}
    public function foo(): \Other\FunctionReturnType
    {
        try {
            \Other\StaticFunctionCall::bar();
        } catch (\Other\CaughtThrowable $e) {}
    }
}
',
                    ['import_symbols' => true]
                ),
            ]
        );
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     *
     * Must run before NoSuperfluousPhpdocTagsFixer, OrderedImportsFixer, StatementIndentationFixer.
     * Must run after PhpdocToReturnTypeFixer.
     */
    public function getPriority(): int
    {
        return 7;
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        $this->namespaceState['candidate_kinds'] = [
            T_FUNCTION,
            T_DOC_COMMENT,
            T_IMPLEMENTS,
            T_EXTENDS,
            T_CATCH,
            T_DOUBLE_COLON,
        ];

        $this->namespaceState['is_candidate'] = $tokens->isAnyTokenKindsFound($this->namespaceState['candidate_kinds']);

        return $this->namespaceState['is_candidate'];
    }

    protected function createConfigurationDefinition(): FixerConfigurationResolverInterface
    {
        return new FixerConfigurationResolver([
            (new FixerOptionBuilder(
                'leading_backslash_in_global_namespace',
                'Whether FQCN is prefixed with backslash when that FQCN is used in global namespace context.'
            ))
                ->setAllowedTypes(['bool'])
                ->setDefault(false)
                ->getOption(),
            (new FixerOptionBuilder(
                'import_symbols',
                'Whether FQCNs found during analysis should be automatically imported.'
            ))
                ->setAllowedTypes(['bool'])
                ->setDefault(false)
                ->getOption(),
            (new FixerOptionBuilder(
                'phpdoc_tags',
                'Collection of PHPDoc annotation tags where FQCNs should be processed. As of now only simple tags with `@tag \F\Q\C\N` format are supported (no complex types).'
            ))
                ->setAllowedTypes(['array'])
                ->setDefault([
                    'param',
                    'phpstan-param',
                    'phpstan-property',
                    'phpstan-property-read',
                    'phpstan-property-write',
                    'phpstan-return',
                    'phpstan-var',
                    'property',
                    'property-read',
                    'property-write',
                    'psalm-param',
                    'psalm-property',
                    'psalm-property-read',
                    'psalm-property-write',
                    'psalm-return',
                    'psalm-var',
                    'return',
                    'see',
                    'throws',
                    'var',
                ])
                ->getOption(),
        ]);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $functionsAnalyzer = new FunctionsAnalyzer();
        $this->namespaceState['path'] = $file->getPathname();
        $this->namespaceState['scopes'] = [];
        $this->currentNamespaceIsGlobal();

        foreach ($tokens->getNamespaceDeclarations() as $namespace) {
            $namespaceName = strtolower($namespace->getFullName());
            $this->namespaceState['current'] = $namespaceName;
            $this->namespaceState['scopes'][] = $namespaceName;
            $uses = [];
            $lastUse = null;

            foreach ($this->collectUseDeclarationsInNamespace($tokens, $namespace) as $use) {
                $uses[$this->normaliseSymbolName($use->getFullName())] = $use->getShortName();
                $lastUse = $use;
            }

            for ($index = $namespace->getScopeStartIndex(); $index < $namespace->getScopeEndIndex(); ++$index) {
                if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_FUNCTION)) {
                    $this->fixFunction($functionsAnalyzer, $tokens, $index, $uses, $namespaceName);
                } elseif ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([T_EXTENDS, T_IMPLEMENTS])) {
                    $this->fixExtendsImplements($tokens, $index, $uses, $namespaceName);
                } elseif ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_CATCH)) {
                    $this->fixCatch($tokens, $index, $uses, $namespaceName);
                } elseif ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_DOUBLE_COLON)) {
                    $this->fixClassStaticAccess($tokens, $index, $uses, $namespaceName);
                }

                if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_DOC_COMMENT)) {
                    $this->fixPhpDoc($tokens, $index, $uses, $namespaceName);
                }
            }

            if (true === $this->configuration['import_symbols'] && [] !== $this->symbolsForImport) {
                $atIndex = (null !== $lastUse) ? $lastUse->getEndIndex() + 1 : $namespace->getEndIndex() + 1;

                // Insert all registered FQCNs
                $this->insertCollectedImports($tokens, $this->symbolsForImport, $atIndex);

                $this->symbolsForImport = [];
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function fixFunction(FunctionsAnalyzer $functionsAnalyzer, Tokens $tokens, int $index, array $uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $arguments = $functionsAnalyzer->getFunctionArguments($tokens, $index);

        $this->analysisState['function_index'] = $index;
        $this->analysisState['function_arguments'] = $arguments;

        foreach ($arguments as $i => $argument) {
            $argument = $functionsAnalyzer->getFunctionArguments($tokens, $index)[$i];

            if ($argument->hasTypeAnalysis()) {
                $this->replaceByShortType($tokens, $argument->getTypeAnalysis(), $uses, $namespaceName);
            }
        }

        $returnTypeAnalysis = $functionsAnalyzer->getFunctionReturnType($tokens, $index);

        if (null !== $returnTypeAnalysis) {
            $this->replaceByShortType($tokens, $returnTypeAnalysis, $uses, $namespaceName);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function fixPhpDoc(Tokens $tokens, int $index, array $uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $allowedTags = $this->configuration['phpdoc_tags'];

        $this->typeState['phpdoc_index'] = $index;
        $this->typeState['phpdoc_tags'] = $allowedTags;

        if ([] === $allowedTags) {
            return;
        }

        $phpDoc = $tokens[$index];
        $phpDocContent = $phpDoc->getContent();
        Preg::matchAll('#@([^\s]+)(\s+)([a-zA-Z0-9_\\\\]+)#', $phpDocContent, $matches);

        if ([] !== $matches[0]) {
            foreach ($matches[3] as $i => $typeName) {
                if (!$this->phpDocTagIsAllowed($matches[1][$i])) {
                    continue;
                }

                $this->rememberPhpDocTypeMatch($typeName);

                if (true === $this->configuration['import_symbols'] && isset($matches[3][0])) {
                    $this->registerSymbolForImport('class', $matches[3][0], $uses, $namespaceName);
                }

                $shortTokens = $this->determineShortType($typeName, $uses, $namespaceName);

                if (null !== $shortTokens) {
                    // Replace tag+type in order to avoid replacing type multiple times (when same type is used in multiple places)
                    $phpDocContent = str_replace(
                        $matches[0][$i],
                        '@'.$matches[1][$i].$matches[2][$i].implode('', array_map(
                            static fn (Token $token) => $token->getContent(),
                            $shortTokens
                        )),
                        $phpDocContent
                    );

                    $tokens[$index] = new Token([T_DOC_COMMENT, $phpDocContent]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function fixExtendsImplements(Tokens $tokens, int $index, array $uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        // We handle `extends` and `implements` with similar logic, but we need to exit the loop under different conditions.
        $isExtends = $tokens[$index]->equals([T_EXTENDS]);
        $this->namespaceState['extends'] = $isExtends;
        $this->namespaceState['heritage_index'] = $index;
        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        $extend = ['content' => '', 'tokens' => []];

        while (true) {
            if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny([',', '{', [T_IMPLEMENTS]])) {
                $this->shortenClassIfPossible($tokens, $extend, $uses, $namespaceName);

                if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny($isExtends ? [[T_IMPLEMENTS], '{'] : ['{'])) {
                    break;
                }

                $extend = ['content' => '', 'tokens' => []];
            } else {
                $extend['tokens'][] = $index;
                $extend['content'] .= $tokens[$index]->getContent();
                $this->rememberHeritageClass($extend['content']);
            }

            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function fixCatch(Tokens $tokens, int $index, array $uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index); // '('
        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index); // first part of first exception class to be caught
        $this->namespaceState['catch_index'] = $index;
        $this->rememberCaughtException('');

        $caughtExceptionClass = ['content' => '', 'tokens' => []];

        while (true) {
            if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny([')', [T_VARIABLE], [CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION]])) {
                if (0 === \count($caughtExceptionClass['tokens'])) {
                    break;
                }

                $this->shortenClassIfPossible($tokens, $caughtExceptionClass, $uses, $namespaceName);

                if ($tokens[$index]->equals(')')) {
                    break;
                }

                $caughtExceptionClass = ['content' => '', 'tokens' => []];
            } else {
                $caughtExceptionClass['tokens'][] = $index;
                $caughtExceptionClass['content'] .= $tokens[$index]->getContent();
            }

            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function fixClassStaticAccess(Tokens $tokens, int $index, array $uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $classConstantRef = ['content' => '', 'tokens' => []];

        $this->namespaceState['static_access_index'] = $index;

        while (true) {
            $index = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);

            if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny([[T_STRING], [T_NS_SEPARATOR]])) {
                $classConstantRef['tokens'][] = $index;
                $classConstantRef['content'] = $tokens[$index]->getContent().$classConstantRef['content'];
                $this->rememberStaticReference($classConstantRef['content']);
            } else {
                $classConstantRef['tokens'] = array_reverse($classConstantRef['tokens']);
                $this->shortenClassIfPossible($tokens, $classConstantRef, $uses, $namespaceName);

                break;
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array{content: string, tokens: array<int>} $class
     * @param array<string, string>                      $uses
     */
    private function shortenClassIfPossible(Tokens $tokens, array $class, array $uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $longTypeContent = $class['content'];

        $this->importQueueHasKind('class');

        if (true === $this->configuration['import_symbols']) {
            $this->registerSymbolForImport('class', $longTypeContent, $uses, $namespaceName);
        }

        if (str_starts_with($longTypeContent, '\\')) {
            $typeName = substr($longTypeContent, 1);
            $typeNameLower = strtolower($typeName);

            if ($this->usesContainType($uses, $typeNameLower)) {
                // if the type without leading "\" equals any of the full "uses" long names, it can be replaced with the short one
                $this->replaceClassWithShort($tokens, $class, $uses[$typeNameLower]);
            } elseif ('' === $namespaceName) {
                if (true === $this->configuration['leading_backslash_in_global_namespace']) {
                    // if we are in the global namespace and the type is not imported the leading '\' can be removed
                    $inUses = false;

                    foreach ($uses as $useShortName) {
                        if (strtolower($useShortName) === $typeNameLower) {
                            $inUses = true;

                            break;
                        }
                    }

                    if (!$inUses) {
                        $this->replaceClassWithShort($tokens, $class, $typeName);
                    }
                }
            } elseif (
                $typeNameLower !== $namespaceName
                && str_starts_with($typeNameLower, $namespaceName)
                && '\\' === $typeNameLower[\strlen($namespaceName)]
            ) {
                // if the type starts with namespace and the type is not the same as the namespace it can be shortened
                $typeNameShort = substr($typeName, \strlen($namespaceName) + 1);
                $this->replaceClassWithShort($tokens, $class, $typeNameShort);
            }
        } // else: no shorter type possible
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function replaceByShortType(Tokens $tokens, TypeAnalysis $type, array $uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $typeStartIndex = $type->getStartIndex();

        $this->typeState['type_start'] = $typeStartIndex;
        $this->typeState['type_end'] = $type->getEndIndex();

        if ($tokens[$typeStartIndex]->isGivenKind(CT::T_NULLABLE_TYPE)) {
            $typeStartIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($typeStartIndex);
        }

        $types = $this->getTypes($tokens, $typeStartIndex, $type->getEndIndex());

        foreach ($types as $typeName => [$startIndex, $endIndex]) {
            if ($this->isBuiltInTypeName($typeName)) {
                return;
            }

            if (true === $this->configuration['import_symbols']) {
                $this->registerSymbolForImport('class', $typeName, $uses, $namespaceName);
            }

            $shortType = $this->determineShortType($typeName, $uses, $namespaceName);

            if (null !== $shortType) {
                $tokens->overrideRange($startIndex, $endIndex, $shortType);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Determines short type based on FQCN, current namespace and imports (`use` declarations).
     *
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     *
     * @return null|Token[]
     */
    private function determineShortType(string $typeName, array $uses, string $namespaceName): ?array
    {
        $this->typeState['short_type_name'] = $typeName;
        $withLeadingBackslash = str_starts_with($typeName, '\\');
        if ($withLeadingBackslash) {
            $typeName = substr($typeName, 1);
        }
        $typeNameLower = strtolower($typeName);
        $namespaceNameLength = \strlen($namespaceName);

        if (isset($uses[$typeNameLower]) && ($withLeadingBackslash || '' === $namespaceName)) {
            // if the type without leading "\" equals any of the full "uses" long names, it can be replaced with the short one
            return $this->namespacedStringToTokens($uses[$typeNameLower]);
        }

        if ('' === $namespaceName) {
            // if we are in the global namespace and the type is not imported the leading '\' can be removed (TODO nice config candidate)
            foreach ($uses as $useShortName) {
                if (strtolower($useShortName) === $typeNameLower) {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            // if we are in the global namespace and the type is not imported,
            // we enforce/remove leading backslash (depending on the configuration)
            if (true === $this->configuration['leading_backslash_in_global_namespace']) {
                if (!$withLeadingBackslash && !isset($uses[$typeNameLower])) {
                    return $this->namespacedStringToTokens($typeName, true);
                }
            } else {
                return $this->namespacedStringToTokens($typeName);
            }
        }
        if (!str_contains($typeName, '\\')) {
            // If we're NOT in the global namespace, there's no related import,
            // AND used type is from global namespace, then it can't be shortened.
            return null;
        }
        if ($typeNameLower !== $namespaceName && str_starts_with($typeNameLower, $namespaceName.'\\')) {
            // if the type starts with namespace and the type is not the same as the namespace it can be shortened
            $typeNameShort = substr($typeName, $namespaceNameLength + 1);

            // if short names are the same, but long one are different then it cannot be shortened
            foreach ($uses as $useLongName => $useShortName) {
                if (
                    strtolower($typeNameShort) === strtolower($useShortName)
                    && strtolower($typeName) !== strtolower($useLongName)
                ) {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            return $this->namespacedStringToTokens($typeNameShort);
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * @param array{content: string, tokens: array<int>} $class
     */
    private function replaceClassWithShort(Tokens $tokens, array $class, string $short): void
    {
        $i = 0; // override the tokens
        $this->renderState['short_class'] = $short;
        $this->renderState['class_tokens'] = $class['tokens'];

        foreach ($this->namespacedStringToTokens($short) as $shortToken) {
            $tokens[$class['tokens'][$i]] = $shortToken;
            ++$i;
        }

        // clear the leftovers
        for ($j = \count($class['tokens']) - 1; $j >= $i; --$j) {
            $tokens->clearTokenAndMergeSurroundingWhitespace($class['tokens'][$j]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{int, int}>
     */
    private function getTypes(Tokens $tokens, int $index, int $endIndex): iterable
    {
        $this->typeState['type_scan_start'] = $index;
        $this->typeState['type_scan_end'] = $endIndex;
        $skipNextYield = false;
        $typeStartIndex = $typeEndIndex = null;
        $type = null;
        while (true) {
            if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_OPEN)) {
                $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
                $typeStartIndex = $typeEndIndex = null;
                $type = null;

                continue;
            }

            if (
                $tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION, CT::T_TYPE_INTERSECTION, CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_CLOSE])
                || $index > $endIndex
            ) {
                if (!$skipNextYield && null !== $typeStartIndex) {
                    $origCount = \count($tokens);

                    yield $type => [$typeStartIndex, $typeEndIndex];

                    $endIndex += \count($tokens) - $origCount;

                    // type tokens were possibly updated, restart type match
                    $skipNextYield = true;
                    $index = $typeEndIndex = $typeStartIndex;
                    $type = null;
                } else {
                    $skipNextYield = false;
                    $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
                    $typeStartIndex = $typeEndIndex = null;
                    $type = null;
                }

                if ($index > $endIndex) {
                    break;
                }

                continue;
            }

            if (null === $typeStartIndex) {
                $typeStartIndex = $index;
                $type = '';
            }

            $typeEndIndex = $index;
            $type .= $tokens[$index]->getContent();

            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return list<Token>
     */
    private function namespacedStringToTokens(string $input, bool $withLeadingBackslash = false): array
    {
        $this->renderState['namespaced_input'] = $input;
        $this->renderState['leading_backslash'] = $withLeadingBackslash;
        $tokens = [];

        if ($withLeadingBackslash) {
            $tokens[] = new Token([T_NS_SEPARATOR, '\\']);
        }

        $parts = explode('\\', $input);
        foreach ($parts as $index => $part) {
            $tokens[] = new Token([T_STRING, $part]);

            if ($index !== \count($parts) - 1) {
                $tokens[] = new Token([T_NS_SEPARATOR, '\\']);
            }
        }

        return $tokens;
    }

    /**
     * @param "class"|"const"|"function" $kind
     * @param class-string               $symbol
     * @param array<string, string>      $uses
     */
    private function registerSymbolForImport(string $kind, string $symbol, array &$uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $normalisedName = $this->normaliseSymbolName($symbol);

        // Do NOT register symbol for importing if:
        if (
            // we already have the symbol in existing imports
            isset($uses[$normalisedName])
            // or if the symbol is not a FQCN
            || !str_starts_with($symbol, '\\')
            // or if it's a global symbol
            || $this->isGlobalSymbolCandidate($symbol)
        ) {
            return;
        }

        $shortSymbol = $this->extractShortSymbol($symbol);

        // If symbol
        if ($this->shortNameConflictsWithUses($shortSymbol, $uses)) {
            return;
        }

        $this->queueSymbolImport($kind, $normalisedName, $symbol);

        // We must fake that the symbol is imported, so that it can be shortened.
        $uses[$normalisedName] = $shortSymbol;
    }

    /**
     * @param class-string $name
     */
    private function normaliseSymbolName(string $name): string
    {
        $this->namespaceState['last_normalised'] = strtolower(ltrim($name, '\\'));

        return $this->namespaceState['last_normalised'];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, ArgumentAnalysis>
     */
    public function collectFunctionArguments(Tokens $tokens, int $functionIndex): array
    {
        $this->analysisState['function_index'] = $functionIndex;
        $this->analysisState['function_hash'] = $tokens->getCodeHash();

        $argumentsStart = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($functionIndex, ['(']);
        $argumentsEnd = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_BRACE, $argumentsStart);
        $arguments = [];

        foreach ($this->collectArgumentRanges($tokens, $argumentsStart, $argumentsEnd) as $start => $end) {
            $argumentInfo = $this->collectArgumentInfo($tokens, $start, $end);
            $arguments[$argumentInfo->getName()] = $argumentInfo;
        }

        $this->analysisState['function_arguments'] = $arguments;

        return $arguments;
    }

    public function collectFunctionReturnType(Tokens $tokens, int $methodIndex): ?TypeAnalysis
    {
        $this->analysisState['return_index'] = $methodIndex;

        $argumentsStart = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($methodIndex, ['(']);
        $argumentsEnd = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_BRACE, $argumentsStart);
        $typeColonIndex = $this->nextMeaningfulIndex($tokens, $argumentsEnd);

        if (!$this->isCursorOnKind($tokens, $typeColonIndex, CT::T_TYPE_COLON)) {
            $this->analysisState['return_type'] = null;

            return null;
        }

        $type = '';
        $typeStartIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($typeColonIndex);
        $typeEndIndex = $typeStartIndex;
        $functionBodyStart = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($typeColonIndex, ['{', ';', [T_DOUBLE_ARROW]]);

        for ($i = $typeStartIndex; $i < $functionBodyStart; ++$i) {
            $i = $this->skipWhitespaceAndCommentIndex($tokens, $i, $functionBodyStart);
            if ($i >= $functionBodyStart) {
                break;
            }

            $type .= $tokens[$i]->getContent();
            $typeEndIndex = $i;
        }

        $this->analysisState['return_type'] = $type;

        return new TypeAnalysis($type, $typeStartIndex, $typeEndIndex);
    }

    public function isTheSameClassCall(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        $this->analysisState['same_class_index'] = $index;

        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($index)) {
            return false;
        }

        $operatorIndex = $this->previousMeaningfulIndex($tokens, $index);

        if (null === $operatorIndex) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!$tokens[$operatorIndex]->isObjectOperator() && !$tokens[$operatorIndex]->isGivenKind(T_DOUBLE_COLON)) {
            return false;
        }

        $referenceIndex = $this->previousMeaningfulIndex($tokens, $operatorIndex);

        if (null === $referenceIndex) {
            return false;
        }

        $isSameClass = $tokens[$referenceIndex]->equalsAny([[T_VARIABLE, '$this'], [T_STRING, 'self'], [T_STATIC, 'static']], false);
        $this->analysisState['same_class_call'] = $isSameClass;

        return $isSameClass;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, int>
     */
    public function collectArgumentRanges(Tokens $tokens, int $openParenthesis, int $closeParenthesis): array
    {
        $this->analysisState['argument_open'] = $openParenthesis;
        $this->analysisState['argument_close'] = $closeParenthesis;

        $arguments = [];
        $firstSensibleToken = $this->nextMeaningfulIndex($tokens, $openParenthesis);

        if ($tokens[$firstSensibleToken]->equals(')')) {
            $this->analysisState['argument_ranges'] = [];

            return $arguments;
        }

        $paramContentIndex = $openParenthesis + 1;
        $argumentsStart = $paramContentIndex;

        for (; $paramContentIndex < $closeParenthesis; ++$paramContentIndex) {
            $paramContentIndex = $this->skipNestedArgumentConstruct($tokens, $paramContentIndex);

            if ($tokens[$paramContentIndex]->equals(',')) {
                if ($tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($paramContentIndex) === $closeParenthesis) {
                    break;
                }

                $arguments[$argumentsStart] = $paramContentIndex - 1;
                $argumentsStart = $paramContentIndex + 1;
            }
        }

        $arguments[$argumentsStart] = $paramContentIndex - 1;
        $this->analysisState['argument_ranges'] = $arguments;

        return $arguments;
    }

    public function collectArgumentInfo(Tokens $tokens, int $argumentStart, int $argumentEnd): ArgumentAnalysis
    {
        $this->analysisState['argument_info_start'] = $argumentStart;
        $this->analysisState['argument_info_end'] = $argumentEnd;

        $skipTypes = $this->argumentInfoSkipKinds();
        $info = [
            'default' => null,
            'name' => null,
            'name_index' => null,
            'type' => null,
            'type_index_start' => null,
            'type_index_end' => null,
        ];
        $sawName = false;

        for ($index = $argumentStart; $index <= $argumentEnd; ++$index) {
            $token = $tokens[$index];

            if (\defined('T_ATTRIBUTE') && $token->isGivenKind(T_ATTRIBUTE)) {
                $index = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_ATTRIBUTE, $index);

                continue;
            }

            if (
                $token->isComment()
                || $token->isWhitespace()
                || $token->isGivenKind($skipTypes)
                || $token->equals('&')
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            if ($token->isGivenKind(T_VARIABLE)) {
                $sawName = true;
                $info['name_index'] = $index;
                $info['name'] = $this->tokenContentAt($tokens, $index) ?? $token->getContent();

                continue;
            }

            if ($token->equals('=')) {
                continue;
            }

            if ($sawName) {
                $info['default'] .= $token->getContent();
            } else {
                $info['type_index_start'] = ($info['type_index_start'] > 0) ? $info['type_index_start'] : $index;
                $info['type_index_end'] = $index;
                $info['type'] .= $token->getContent();
            }
        }

        if (null === $info['name']) {
            $info['type'] = null;
        }

        $this->analysisState['argument_info'] = $info;

        return new ArgumentAnalysis(
            $info['name'],
            $info['name_index'],
            $info['default'],
            null !== $info['type'] ? new TypeAnalysis($info['type'], $info['type_index_start'], $info['type_index_end']) : null
        );
    }

    public function countCollectedArguments(Tokens $tokens, int $openParenthesis, int $closeParenthesis): int
    {
        $this->analysisState['argument_count'] = \count($this->collectArgumentRanges($tokens, $openParenthesis, $closeParenthesis));

        return $this->analysisState['argument_count'];
    }

    /**
     * @return list<int>
     */
    private function argumentInfoSkipKinds(): array
    {
        $skipTypes = [
            T_ELLIPSIS,
            CT::T_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTY_PROMOTION_PUBLIC,
            CT::T_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTY_PROMOTION_PROTECTED,
            CT::T_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTY_PROMOTION_PRIVATE,
        ];

        if (\defined('T_READONLY')) {
            $skipTypes[] = T_READONLY;
        }

        $this->analysisState['argument_skip_kinds'] = $skipTypes;

        return $skipTypes;
    }

    private function skipNestedArgumentConstruct(Tokens $tokens, int $index): int
    {
        $this->analysisState['nested_argument_index'] = $index;
        $blockDefinitionProbe = Tokens::detectBlockType($tokens[$index]);

        if (null !== $blockDefinitionProbe && true === $blockDefinitionProbe['isStart']) {
            $index = $tokens->findBlockEnd($blockDefinitionProbe['type'], $index);
        }

        $this->analysisState['nested_argument_end'] = $index;

        return $index;
    }

    public function isBuiltInTypeName(string $name): bool
    {
        $this->ensureReservedTypeMap();
        $normalized = $this->normalizeTypeNameForReservedCheck($name);
        $this->typeState['last_built_in_check'] = $normalized;

        return isset($this->typeState['reserved_types'][$normalized]);
    }

    private function ensureReservedTypeMap(): void
    {
        if (isset($this->typeState['reserved_types']) && \is_array($this->typeState['reserved_types'])) {
            return;
        }

        $this->typeState['reserved_types'] = array_flip([
            'array',
            'bool',
            'callable',
            'false',
            'float',
            'int',
            'iterable',
            'mixed',
            'never',
            'null',
            'object',
            'parent',
            'resource',
            'self',
            'static',
            'string',
            'true',
            'void',
        ]);
    }

    private function normalizeTypeNameForReservedCheck(string $name): string
    {
        if (str_starts_with($name, '?')) {
            $name = substr($name, 1);
        }

        $this->typeState['normalized_reserved_type'] = strtolower($name);

        return $this->typeState['normalized_reserved_type'];
    }

    private function phpDocTagIsAllowed(string $tag): bool
    {
        $allowedTags = $this->typeState['phpdoc_tags'] ?? $this->configuration['phpdoc_tags'];
        $this->typeState['last_phpdoc_tag'] = $tag;

        return \in_array($tag, $allowedTags, true);
    }

    private function rememberPhpDocTypeMatch(string $typeName): void
    {
        $matches = $this->typeState['phpdoc_types'] ?? [];
        $matches[] = $typeName;
        $this->typeState['phpdoc_types'] = $matches;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<NamespaceUseAnalysis>
     */
    public function collectUseDeclarationsFromTokens(Tokens $tokens): array
    {
        $this->namespaceState['use_token_kind'] = T_USE;
        $tokenAnalyzer = new TokensAnalyzer($tokens);

        return $this->collectUseDeclarationsFromIndices($tokens, $tokenAnalyzer->getImportUseIndexes());
    }

    /**
     * @return list<NamespaceUseAnalysis>
     */
    public function collectUseDeclarationsInNamespace(Tokens $tokens, NamespaceAnalysis $namespace): array
    {
        $this->namespaceState['use_namespace'] = $namespace->getFullName();
        $this->namespaceState['use_scope_start'] = $namespace->getScopeStartIndex();
        $this->namespaceState['use_scope_end'] = $namespace->getScopeEndIndex();

        $uses = [];

        foreach ($this->collectUseDeclarationsFromTokens($tokens) as $namespaceUse) {
            if ($this->useIsInNamespaceScope($namespaceUse, $namespace)) {
                $uses[] = $namespaceUse;
            }
        }

        $this->namespaceState['namespace_uses'] = $uses;

        return $uses;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<int> $useIndices
     *
     * @return list<NamespaceUseAnalysis>
     */
    private function collectUseDeclarationsFromIndices(Tokens $tokens, array $useIndices): array
    {
        $this->namespaceState['use_indices'] = $useIndices;
        $uses = [];

        foreach ($useIndices as $index) {
            $endIndex = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($index, [';', [T_CLOSE_TAG]]);
            $analysis = $this->parseUseDeclaration($tokens, $index, $endIndex);

            if (null !== $analysis) {
                $uses[] = $analysis;
            }
        }

        $this->namespaceState['parsed_uses'] = $uses;

        return $uses;
    }

    private function parseUseDeclaration(Tokens $tokens, int $startIndex, int $endIndex): ?NamespaceUseAnalysis
    {
        $this->namespaceState['use_parse_start'] = $startIndex;
        $this->namespaceState['use_parse_end'] = $endIndex;

        $fullName = $shortName = '';
        $aliased = false;
        $type = NamespaceUseAnalysis::TYPE_CLASS;

        for ($i = $startIndex; $i <= $endIndex; ++$i) {
            $token = $tokens[$i];
            if ($token->equals(',') || $token->isGivenKind(CT::T_GROUP_IMPORT_BRACE_CLOSE)) {
                return null;
            }

            $classified = $this->classifyUseType($tokens, $i);
            if (NamespaceUseAnalysis::TYPE_CLASS !== $classified) {
                $type = $classified;
            }

            if ($token->isWhitespace() || $token->isComment() || $token->isGivenKind(T_USE)) {
                continue;
            }

            if ($token->isGivenKind(T_STRING)) {
                $shortName = $token->getContent();
                if (!$aliased) {
                    $fullName .= $shortName;
                }
            } elseif ($token->isGivenKind(T_NS_SEPARATOR)) {
                $fullName .= $token->getContent();
            } elseif ($token->isGivenKind(T_AS)) {
                $aliased = true;
            }
        }

        $analysis = new NamespaceUseAnalysis(
            trim($fullName),
            $shortName,
            $aliased,
            $startIndex,
            $endIndex,
            $type
        );
        $this->namespaceState['last_use'] = $analysis;

        return $analysis;
    }

    private function useIsInNamespaceScope(NamespaceUseAnalysis $namespaceUse, NamespaceAnalysis $namespace): bool
    {
        $inScope = $namespaceUse->getStartIndex() >= $namespace->getScopeStartIndex()
            && $namespaceUse->getStartIndex() <= $namespace->getScopeEndIndex();
        $this->namespaceState['use_in_scope'] = $inScope;

        return $inScope;
    }

    private function classifyUseType(Tokens $tokens, int $index): int
    {
        $type = NamespaceUseAnalysis::TYPE_CLASS;

        if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(CT::T_FUNCTION_IMPORT)) {
            $type = NamespaceUseAnalysis::TYPE_FUNCTION;
        } elseif ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(CT::T_CONST_IMPORT)) {
            $type = NamespaceUseAnalysis::TYPE_CONSTANT;
        }

        $this->namespaceState['classified_use_type'] = $type;

        return $type;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<NamespaceAnalysis>
     */
    private function currentNamespaceIsGlobal(): bool
    {
        $name = $this->namespaceState['current'] ?? '';
        $this->namespaceState['current_is_global'] = '' === $name;

        return $this->namespaceState['current_is_global'];
    }

    private function rememberHeritageClass(string $content): void
    {
        $classes = $this->namespaceState['heritage_classes'] ?? [];
        $classes[] = $content;
        $this->namespaceState['heritage_classes'] = $classes;
    }

    private function rememberCaughtException(string $content): void
    {
        $exceptions = $this->namespaceState['caught_exceptions'] ?? [];
        $exceptions[] = $content;
        $this->namespaceState['caught_exceptions'] = $exceptions;
    }

    private function rememberStaticReference(string $content): void
    {
        $this->namespaceState['static_reference'] = $content;
    }

    /**
     * @param array{
     *     const?: array<int|string, class-string>,
     *     class?: array<int|string, class-string>,
     *     function?: array<int|string, class-string>
     * } $imports
     */
    public function insertCollectedImports(Tokens $tokens, array $imports, int $atIndex, $whitespacesConfig = null): void
    {
        $config = $whitespacesConfig ?? $this->whitespacesConfig;
        $lineEnding = $config->getLineEnding();
        $this->renderState['line_ending'] = $lineEnding;
        $this->renderState['insert_index'] = $atIndex;
        $this->renderState['import_kinds'] = array_keys($imports);

        if ($this->shouldInsertImportLineEnding($tokens, $atIndex)) {
            $tokens->insertAt($atIndex, new Token([T_WHITESPACE, $lineEnding]));
        }

        foreach ($imports as $type => $typeImports) {
            if (!\is_array($typeImports)) {
                continue;
            }

            $items = [];

            foreach ($this->sortImportNames($typeImports) as $name) {
                if (!\is_string($name)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $items = array_merge($items, $this->buildImportStatementTokens($type, $name, $lineEnding));
            }

            $tokens->insertAt($atIndex, $items);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return list<Token>
     */
    public static function tokenizeImportedName(string $name): array
    {
        return (new self())->buildImportedNameTokens($name);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<Token>
     */
    public function buildImportedNameTokens(string $name): array
    {
        $this->renderState['imported_name'] = $name;
        $parts = explode('\\', $name);
        $newTokens = [];

        if ('' === $parts[0]) {
            $newTokens[] = new Token([T_NS_SEPARATOR, '\\']);
            array_shift($parts);
        }

        foreach ($parts as $part) {
            $newTokens[] = new Token([T_STRING, $part]);
            $newTokens[] = new Token([T_NS_SEPARATOR, '\\']);
        }

        array_pop($newTokens);
        $this->renderState['imported_name_token_count'] = \count($newTokens);

        return $newTokens;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<Token>
     */
    private function buildImportStatementTokens(string $type, string $name, string $lineEnding): array
    {
        $this->renderState['statement_type'] = $type;
        $this->renderState['statement_name'] = $name;

        $items = [
            new Token([T_WHITESPACE, $lineEnding]),
            new Token([T_USE, 'use']),
            new Token([T_WHITESPACE, ' ']),
        ];

        $items = array_merge($items, $this->importKindPrefixTokens($type));
        $items = array_merge($items, $this->buildImportedNameTokens($name));
        $items[] = new Token(';');

        return $items;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<Token>
     */
    private function importKindPrefixTokens(string $type): array
    {
        $this->renderState['prefix_type'] = $type;

        if ('const' === $type) {
            return [
                new Token([CT::T_CONST_IMPORT, 'const']),
                new Token([T_WHITESPACE, ' ']),
            ];
        }

        if ('function' === $type) {
            return [
                new Token([CT::T_FUNCTION_IMPORT, 'function']),
                new Token([T_WHITESPACE, ' ']),
            ];
        }

        return [];
    }

    private function shouldInsertImportLineEnding(Tokens $tokens, int $atIndex): bool
    {
        $this->renderState['line_ending_check_index'] = $atIndex;
        $needsLine = !$tokens[$atIndex]->isWhitespace() || !str_contains($tokens[$atIndex]->getContent(), "\n");
        $this->renderState['needs_line_ending'] = $needsLine;

        return $needsLine;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int|string, mixed> $typeImports
     *
     * @return list<mixed>
     */
    private function sortImportNames(array $typeImports): array
    {
        sort($typeImports);
        $this->renderState['sorted_imports'] = $typeImports;

        return $typeImports;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function queuedImportShortNames(array $uses): array
    {
        $this->importQueueHasKind('class');

        return array_map(
            static fn (string $name): string => strtolower($name),
            array_values($uses)
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function shortNameConflictsWithUses(string $shortSymbol, array $uses): bool
    {
        return \in_array(strtolower($shortSymbol), $this->queuedImportShortNames($uses), true);
    }

    private function isGlobalSymbolCandidate(string $symbol): bool
    {
        return strpos($symbol, '\\') === strrpos($symbol, '\\');
    }

    private function extractShortSymbol(string $symbol): string
    {
        $this->importQueueHasKind('class');

        return substr($symbol, strrpos($symbol, '\\') + 1);
    }

    private function importQueueHasKind(string $kind): bool
    {
        return isset($this->symbolsForImport[$kind]) && \is_array($this->symbolsForImport[$kind]);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function usesContainType(array $uses, string $typeNameLower): bool
    {
        $this->importQueueHasKind('class');

        return isset($uses[$typeNameLower]);
    }

    private function queueSymbolImport(string $kind, string $normalisedName, string $symbol): void
    {
        $this->symbolsForImport[$kind][$normalisedName] = ltrim($symbol, '\\');
        ksort($this->symbolsForImport[$kind], SORT_NATURAL);
    }

    private function nextMeaningfulIndex(Tokens $tokens, int $index): ?int
    {
        $next = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        $this->tokenCursorState['next'] = $next;
        $this->tokenCursorState['from'] = $index;
        $this->rememberTokenCursor('next', $next);

        return $next;
    }

    private function previousMeaningfulIndex(Tokens $tokens, int $index): ?int
    {
        $previous = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);
        $this->tokenCursorState['previous'] = $previous;
        $this->tokenCursorState['from'] = $index;
        $this->rememberTokenCursor('previous', $previous);

        return $previous;
    }

    private function rememberTokenCursor(string $role, ?int $index): ?int
    {
        $this->tokenCursorState[$role] = $index;
        $this->tokenCursorState['last_role'] = $role;
        $this->tokenCursorHasRole($role);

        return $index;
    }

    private function tokenCursorHasRole(string $role): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($role, $this->tokenCursorState) && null !== $this->tokenCursorState[$role];
    }

    private function skipWhitespaceAndCommentIndex(Tokens $tokens, int $index, int $limit): int
    {
        while ($index < $limit && ($tokens[$index]->isWhitespace() || $tokens[$index]->isComment())) {
            ++$index;
        }

        $this->tokenCursorState['skipped_to'] = $index;
        $this->tokenCursorState['skip_limit'] = $limit;

        return $index;
    }

    private function tokenContentAt(Tokens $tokens, ?int $index): ?string
    {
        if (null === $index || !$tokens->offsetExists($index)) {
            $this->tokenCursorState['missing'] = $index;

            return null;
        }

        $this->tokenCursorState['content_index'] = $index;

        return $tokens[$index]->getContent();
    }

    private function isCursorOnKind(Tokens $tokens, ?int $index, $kind): bool
    {
        if (null === $index || !$tokens->offsetExists($index)) {
            $this->tokenCursorState['kind_miss'] = $kind;

            return false;
        }

        $this->tokenCursorState['kind_index'] = $index;

        return $tokens[$index]->isGivenKind($kind);
    }

                ])

    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $namespaceUsesAnalyzer = new NamespaceUsesAnalyzer();
        $functionsAnalyzer = new FunctionsAnalyzer();

        foreach ($tokens->getNamespaceDeclarations() as $namespace) {
            $namespaceName = strtolower($namespace->getFullName());
            $uses = [];
            $lastUse = null;

            foreach ($namespaceUsesAnalyzer->getDeclarationsInNamespace($tokens, $namespace) as $use) {
                $uses[$this->normaliseSymbolName($use->getFullName())] = $use->getShortName();
                $lastUse = $use;
            }

            for ($index = $namespace->getScopeStartIndex(); $index < $namespace->getScopeEndIndex(); ++$index) {
                if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_FUNCTION)) {
                    $this->fixFunction($functionsAnalyzer, $tokens, $index, $uses, $namespaceName);
                } elseif ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([T_EXTENDS, T_IMPLEMENTS])) {
                    $this->fixExtendsImplements($tokens, $index, $uses, $namespaceName);
                } elseif ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_CATCH)) {
                    $this->fixCatch($tokens, $index, $uses, $namespaceName);
                } elseif ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_DOUBLE_COLON)) {
                    $this->fixClassStaticAccess($tokens, $index, $uses, $namespaceName);
                }

                if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_DOC_COMMENT)) {
                    $this->fixPhpDoc($tokens, $index, $uses, $namespaceName);
                }
            }

            if (true === $this->configuration['import_symbols'] && [] !== $this->symbolsForImport) {
                $atIndex = (null !== $lastUse) ? $lastUse->getEndIndex() + 1 : $namespace->getEndIndex() + 1;

                // Insert all registered FQCNs
                $this->createImportProcessor()->insertImports($tokens, $this->symbolsForImport, $atIndex);

                $this->symbolsForImport = [];
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function fixFunction(FunctionsAnalyzer $functionsAnalyzer, Tokens $tokens, int $index, array &$uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $arguments = $functionsAnalyzer->getFunctionArguments($tokens, $index);

        foreach ($arguments as $i => $argument) {
            $argument = $functionsAnalyzer->getFunctionArguments($tokens, $index)[$i];

            if ($argument->hasTypeAnalysis()) {
                $this->replaceByShortType($tokens, $argument->getTypeAnalysis(), $uses, $namespaceName);
            }
        }

        $returnTypeAnalysis = $functionsAnalyzer->getFunctionReturnType($tokens, $index);

        if (null !== $returnTypeAnalysis) {
            $this->replaceByShortType($tokens, $returnTypeAnalysis, $uses, $namespaceName);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function fixPhpDoc(Tokens $tokens, int $index, array &$uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $allowedTags = $this->configuration['phpdoc_tags'];

        if ([] === $allowedTags) {
            return;
        }

        $phpDoc = $tokens[$index];
        $phpDocContent = $phpDoc->getContent();
        Preg::matchAll('#@([^\s]+)(\s+)([a-zA-Z0-9_\\\\]+)#', $phpDocContent, $matches);

        if ([] !== $matches[0]) {
            foreach ($matches[3] as $i => $typeName) {
                if (!\in_array($matches[1][$i], $allowedTags, true)) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (true === $this->configuration['import_symbols'] && isset($matches[3][0])) {
                    $this->registerSymbolForImport('class', $matches[3][0], $uses, $namespaceName);
                }

                $shortTokens = $this->determineShortType($typeName, $uses, $namespaceName);

                if (null !== $shortTokens) {
                    // Replace tag+type in order to avoid replacing type multiple times (when same type is used in multiple places)
                    $phpDocContent = str_replace(
                        $matches[0][$i],
                        '@'.$matches[1][$i].$matches[2][$i].implode('', array_map(
                            static fn (Token $token) => $token->getContent(),
                            $shortTokens
                        )),
                        $phpDocContent
                    );

                    $tokens[$index] = new Token([T_DOC_COMMENT, $phpDocContent]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function fixExtendsImplements(Tokens $tokens, int $index, array &$uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        // We handle `extends` and `implements` with similar logic, but we need to exit the loop under different conditions.
        $isExtends = $tokens[$index]->equals([T_EXTENDS]);
        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        $extend = ['content' => '', 'tokens' => []];

        while (true) {
            if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny([',', '{', [T_IMPLEMENTS]])) {
                $this->shortenClassIfPossible($tokens, $extend, $uses, $namespaceName);

                if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny($isExtends ? [[T_IMPLEMENTS], '{'] : ['{'])) {
                    break;
                }

                $extend = ['content' => '', 'tokens' => []];
            } else {
                $extend['tokens'][] = $index;
                $extend['content'] .= $tokens[$index]->getContent();
            }

            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function fixCatch(Tokens $tokens, int $index, array &$uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index); // '('
        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index); // first part of first exception class to be caught

        $caughtExceptionClass = ['content' => '', 'tokens' => []];

        while (true) {
            if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny([')', [T_VARIABLE], [CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION]])) {
                if (0 === \count($caughtExceptionClass['tokens'])) {
                    break;
                }

                $this->shortenClassIfPossible($tokens, $caughtExceptionClass, $uses, $namespaceName);

                if ($tokens[$index]->equals(')')) {
                    break;
                }

                $caughtExceptionClass = ['content' => '', 'tokens' => []];
            } else {
                $caughtExceptionClass['tokens'][] = $index;
                $caughtExceptionClass['content'] .= $tokens[$index]->getContent();
            }

            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function fixClassStaticAccess(Tokens $tokens, int $index, array &$uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $classConstantRef = ['content' => '', 'tokens' => []];

        while (true) {
            $index = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);

            if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny([[T_STRING], [T_NS_SEPARATOR]])) {
                $classConstantRef['tokens'][] = $index;
                $classConstantRef['content'] = $tokens[$index]->getContent().$classConstantRef['content'];
            } else {
                $classConstantRef['tokens'] = array_reverse($classConstantRef['tokens']);
                $this->shortenClassIfPossible($tokens, $classConstantRef, $uses, $namespaceName);

                break;
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array{content: string, tokens: array<int>} $class
     * @param array<string, string>                      $uses
     */
    private function shortenClassIfPossible(Tokens $tokens, array $class, array &$uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $longTypeContent = $class['content'];

        if (true === $this->configuration['import_symbols']) {
            $this->registerSymbolForImport('class', $longTypeContent, $uses, $namespaceName);
        }

        if (str_starts_with($longTypeContent, '\\')) {
            $typeName = substr($longTypeContent, 1);
            $typeNameLower = strtolower($typeName);

            if (isset($uses[$typeNameLower])) {
                // if the type without leading "\" equals any of the full "uses" long names, it can be replaced with the short one
                $this->replaceClassWithShort($tokens, $class, $uses[$typeNameLower]);
            } elseif ('' === $namespaceName) {
                if (true === $this->configuration['leading_backslash_in_global_namespace']) {
                    // if we are in the global namespace and the type is not imported the leading '\' can be removed
                    $inUses = false;

                    foreach ($uses as $useShortName) {
                        if (strtolower($useShortName) === $typeNameLower) {
                            $inUses = true;

                            break;
                        }
                    }

                    if (!$inUses) {
                        $this->replaceClassWithShort($tokens, $class, $typeName);
                    }
                }
            } elseif (
                $typeNameLower !== $namespaceName
                && str_starts_with($typeNameLower, $namespaceName)
                && '\\' === $typeNameLower[\strlen($namespaceName)]
            ) {
                // if the type starts with namespace and the type is not the same as the namespace it can be shortened
                $typeNameShort = substr($typeName, \strlen($namespaceName) + 1);
                $this->replaceClassWithShort($tokens, $class, $typeNameShort);
            }
        } // else: no shorter type possible
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     */
    private function replaceByShortType(Tokens $tokens, TypeAnalysis $type, array &$uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $typeStartIndex = $type->getStartIndex();

        if ($tokens[$typeStartIndex]->isGivenKind(CT::T_NULLABLE_TYPE)) {
            $typeStartIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($typeStartIndex);
        }

        $types = $this->getTypes($tokens, $typeStartIndex, $type->getEndIndex());

        foreach ($types as $typeName => [$startIndex, $endIndex]) {
            if ((new TypeAnalysis($typeName))->isReservedType()) {
                return;
            }

            if (true === $this->configuration['import_symbols']) {
                $this->registerSymbolForImport('class', $typeName, $uses, $namespaceName);
            }

            $shortType = $this->determineShortType($typeName, $uses, $namespaceName);

            if (null !== $shortType) {
                $tokens->overrideRange($startIndex, $endIndex, $shortType);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Determines short type based on FQCN, current namespace and imports (`use` declarations).
     *
     * @param array<string, string> $uses
     *
     * @return null|Token[]
     */
    private function determineShortType(string $typeName, array $uses, string $namespaceName): ?array
    {
        $withLeadingBackslash = str_starts_with($typeName, '\\');
        if ($withLeadingBackslash) {
            $typeName = substr($typeName, 1);
        }
        $typeNameLower = strtolower($typeName);
        $namespaceNameLength = \strlen($namespaceName);

        if (isset($uses[$typeNameLower]) && ($withLeadingBackslash || '' === $namespaceName)) {
            // if the type without leading "\" equals any of the full "uses" long names, it can be replaced with the short one
            return $this->namespacedStringToTokens($uses[$typeNameLower]);
        }

        if ('' === $namespaceName) {
            // if we are in the global namespace and the type is not imported the leading '\' can be removed (TODO nice config candidate)
            foreach ($uses as $useShortName) {
                if (strtolower($useShortName) === $typeNameLower) {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            // if we are in the global namespace and the type is not imported,
            // we enforce/remove leading backslash (depending on the configuration)
            if (true === $this->configuration['leading_backslash_in_global_namespace']) {
                if (!$withLeadingBackslash && !isset($uses[$typeNameLower])) {
                    return $this->namespacedStringToTokens($typeName, true);
                }
            } else {
                return $this->namespacedStringToTokens($typeName);
            }
        }
        if (!str_contains($typeName, '\\')) {
            // If we're NOT in the global namespace, there's no related import,
            // AND used type is from global namespace, then it can't be shortened.
            return null;
        }
        if ($typeNameLower !== $namespaceName && str_starts_with($typeNameLower, $namespaceName.'\\')) {
            // if the type starts with namespace and the type is not the same as the namespace it can be shortened
            $typeNameShort = substr($typeName, $namespaceNameLength + 1);

            // if short names are the same, but long one are different then it cannot be shortened
            foreach ($uses as $useLongName => $useShortName) {
                if (
                    strtolower($typeNameShort) === strtolower($useShortName)
                    && strtolower($typeName) !== strtolower($useLongName)
                ) {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            return $this->namespacedStringToTokens($typeNameShort);
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * @param array{content: string, tokens: array<int>} $class
     */
    private function replaceClassWithShort(Tokens $tokens, array $class, string $short): void
    {
        $i = 0; // override the tokens

        foreach ($this->namespacedStringToTokens($short) as $shortToken) {
            $tokens[$class['tokens'][$i]] = $shortToken;
            ++$i;
        }

        // clear the leftovers
        for ($j = \count($class['tokens']) - 1; $j >= $i; --$j) {
            $tokens->clearTokenAndMergeSurroundingWhitespace($class['tokens'][$j]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{int, int}>
     */
    private function getTypes(Tokens $tokens, int $index, int $endIndex): iterable
    {
        $skipNextYield = false;
        $typeStartIndex = $typeEndIndex = null;
        $type = null;
        while (true) {
            if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_OPEN)) {
                $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
                $typeStartIndex = $typeEndIndex = null;
                $type = null;

                continue;
            }

            if (
                $tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION, CT::T_TYPE_INTERSECTION, CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_CLOSE])
                || $index > $endIndex
            ) {
                if (!$skipNextYield && null !== $typeStartIndex) {
                    $origCount = \count($tokens);

                    yield $type => [$typeStartIndex, $typeEndIndex];

                    $endIndex += \count($tokens) - $origCount;

                    // type tokens were possibly updated, restart type match
                    $skipNextYield = true;
                    $index = $typeEndIndex = $typeStartIndex;
                    $type = null;
                } else {
                    $skipNextYield = false;
                    $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
                    $typeStartIndex = $typeEndIndex = null;
                    $type = null;
                }

                if ($index > $endIndex) {
                    break;
                }

                continue;
            }

            if (null === $typeStartIndex) {
                $typeStartIndex = $index;
                $type = '';
            }

            $typeEndIndex = $index;
            $type .= $tokens[$index]->getContent();

            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return list<Token>
     */
    private function namespacedStringToTokens(string $input, bool $withLeadingBackslash = false): array
    {
        $tokens = [];

        if ($withLeadingBackslash) {
            $tokens[] = new Token([T_NS_SEPARATOR, '\\']);
        }

        $parts = explode('\\', $input);
        foreach ($parts as $index => $part) {
            $tokens[] = new Token([T_STRING, $part]);

            if ($index !== \count($parts) - 1) {
                $tokens[] = new Token([T_NS_SEPARATOR, '\\']);
            }
        }

        return $tokens;
    }

    /**
     * We need to create import processor dynamically (not in costructor), because actual whitespace configuration
     * is set later, not when fixer's instance is created.
     */
    private function createImportProcessor(): ImportProcessor
    {
        return new ImportProcessor($this->whitespacesConfig);
    }

    /**
     * @param "class"|"const"|"function" $kind
     * @param class-string               $symbol
     * @param array<string, string>      $uses
     */
    private function registerSymbolForImport(string $kind, string $symbol, array &$uses, string $namespaceName): void
    {
        $normalisedName = $this->normaliseSymbolName($symbol);

        // Do NOT register symbol for importing if:
        if (
            // we already have the symbol in existing imports
            isset($uses[$normalisedName])
            // or if the symbol is not a FQCN
            || !str_starts_with($symbol, '\\')
            // or if it's a global symbol
            || strpos($symbol, '\\') === strrpos($symbol, '\\')
        ) {
            return;
        }

        $shortSymbol = substr($symbol, strrpos($symbol, '\\') + 1);
        $importedShortNames = array_map(
            static fn (string $name): string => strtolower($name),
            array_values($uses)
        );

        // If symbol
        if (\in_array(strtolower($shortSymbol), $importedShortNames, true)) {
            return;
        }

        $this->symbolsForImport[$kind][$normalisedName] = ltrim($symbol, '\\');
        ksort($this->symbolsForImport[$kind], SORT_NATURAL);

        // We must fake that the symbol is imported, so that it can be shortened.
        $uses[$normalisedName] = $shortSymbol;
    }

    /**
     * @param class-string $name
     */
    private function normaliseSymbolName(string $name): string
    {
        return strtolower(ltrim($name, '\\'));
    }

**Root cause:** In `FullyQualifiedStrictTypesFixer`, the `$uses` map (import declarations) was passed **by value** through the call chain (`fixFunction`, `fixPhpDoc`, `fixExtendsImplements`, `fixCatch`, `fixClassStaticAccess`, `shortenClassIfPossible`, `replaceByShortType`). When `import_symbols` is enabled, `registerSymbolForImport` adds a "fake" import entry to `$uses` after registering a symbol, but that mutation was lost between calls. As a result, when multiple FQCNs share a short name but come from different namespaces (e.g. `use A\A;` plus `\B\A`, `\C\A`, …), each subsequent symbol was blind to the conflict, got imported, and was wrongly shortened to the colliding short name.

**Fix:** Matched the upstream v3.43.1 patch — the seven private helpers now take `array &$uses` by reference (src/Fixer/Import/FullyQualifiedStrictTypesFixer.php:302, 327, 376, 407, 441, 467, 516), so conflict detection sees previously registered symbols and leaves same-name/different-namespace references untouched.

**Verification:** The FAIL_TO_PASS case ("import short name only once (ignore consequent same-name, different-namespace symbols)") now passes, and all other Import fixer tests pass. The full suite (38308 tests) shows only failures that also exist at baseline (environment-dependent Smoke tests, a cache IO test, an AutoReview violation from pre-existing public methods, and a duplicate data-provider key in the test file itself, which I'm not allowed to modify).
